title: Build a process table with PCBs and a state machine
brief: Create processes, move them through new, ready, running, blocked, zombie, and terminated, orphan children to init, and reap zombies with wait.
hints: The state machine is a dict from each state to the set of states it may move to. `can_transition` is one lookup.
Look up a pid with `self.procs[pid]`, and turn a `KeyError` into `NoSuchProcess` once, in `get`, so every other method can call `get`.
`transition` has three rules to enforce before it changes anything: the move is legal, `zombie` and `terminated` are entered only through `exit` and `wait`, and no other process is already running.
In `exit`, set the state and status first, then hand every child to pid 1: change its `ppid` and append it to init's `children`.
`wait` has three outcomes. A zombie child gives `(pid, status)` and becomes terminated. Live children and no zombie give `None`. No children at all raises `NoChildren`.
